transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi, yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can do light gardening after 1 week, as long as it’s gentle. Try to avoid heavy lifting or strenuous work for a month.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, that sounds manageable. Next, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops or treatment before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful to know. Another question I have is, I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Mild sensitivity to bright light can be normal as your eye adjusts, and wearing sunglasses outside can help.  
But if it is severe, or if your eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and we may need to assess it further.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the advice. My last question is, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's everything I wanted to ask. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you for your assistance!

verdict.label: pass

All points were covered.
